# Clinic management platform: feature notes

Ideas collected after interviews with three small clinics.

## Must-have at launch

- Appointment calendar per doctor with colour-coded rooms
- Patient records: visit notes, allergies, prescriptions
- SMS reminders 24 hours before each visit

## Later

1. Insurance claim exports
2. Inventory tracking for consumables
3. A waiting-room display showing queue positions

Note: receptionists asked for keyboard shortcuts more than anything else.
Pricing: per doctor per month, with a free tier for single-doctor practices.
